# Definitional

This folder contains topics related to the precise clinical and administrative definitions of quality indicators and medical codes used in the Danish healthcare system, specifically within acute surgery and patient mobilization. It details the strict parameters required to measure healthcare quality and standardize patient care metrics, such as the exact timeframes for surgery and mobilization, as well as the specific SKS codes established for tracking preoperative optimization via national databases like the LPR.

## Pages

- [[definitional|Definitional]] — Details the strict clinical parameters and administrative SKS codes required to accurately measure acute surgery and patient mobilization quality indicators in the Danish healthcare system.
